sections.content: Build a complete personal page: semantic layout (header/nav/main/footer), hero section, about, projects list, contact form, and footer. Style it later with CSS.
Requirements checklist: valid HTML5, one h1, alt text on all images, labeled form fields, keyboard-navigable, and passes an HTML validator with zero errors.
Key points: validate at validator.w3.org, test with a screen reader or keyboard only, and view-source to see exactly what you shipped.
Summary: Capstone: Build a Page — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
